{{Top|leg}}
'''Nimbus Trooper''' was the lowest [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] held by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Nimbus commando]]s. The enlisted [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Nationalist Army|Jabiim armed forces]] that successfully underwent grueling indoctrination in the [[Nimbus program]] were welcomed as senior enlisted and received the rank of Nimbus Trooper.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
